color.note: Two colours from the logo, Chilli (orange) and Kheelu Blue (sky), and Sunshine as the one accent, on cream, white and ink. Brand colours are fills: white on Chilli and Kheelu Blue, ink on Sunshine. On light grounds, text and lines are ink. Chilli is for buying, the logo and brand artwork. Kheelu's rainbow stays on the product. Day is the default; Bedtime is the app's night mode.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White: cards and sheets in Day (`surface-raised`), sticker outlines and chalk lines (`chalk`), and the text, ticks and icons on Chilli and Kheelu Blue fills (2.9:1 and 3.0:1, brand decisions).

tokens.name: fur-100
tokens.usage: Cream, Kheelu's fur: THE page background on web, app and decks (`surface`), and the text colour in Bedtime. Text on it: `ink-900` (14.6:1), `ink-600` (6.7:1).

tokens.name: fur-200
tokens.usage: Cream band: alternating section bands, input fills, table headers, and every quiet panel (quotes, FAQs, tips, notices, offer details). Text on it: `ink-900` (13.0:1), `ink-600` (6.0:1).

tokens.name: fur-300
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers in Day (decorative only, never the only edge of a control), and secondary text in Bedtime (10.2:1+ on night grounds).

tokens.name: fur-600
tokens.usage: Control borders in both themes: inputs, toggles, checkboxes, outline icon buttons (3.4:1+ on cream, white and the band; 3.5:1+ on night grounds).

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text in Day: hints, captions, timestamps, legal lines (6.0:1+ on cream, white and the band).

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Ink: text and icons in Day, the chalkboard block, and the text on Sunshine fills (10.8:1) in both themes. Warm near-black, never #000.

tokens.name: chilli-500
tokens.usage: CHILLI, the logo's orange (K, e, e, o, a). The buy button (`cta`), colour blocks, stickers and artwork; never another button or control. Text and icons on it are white: 2.9:1, below WCAG AA (4.5:1) and the 3:1 large-text minimum, kept by brand decision on 9 Oct 2026. Never text on cream or white (2.7:1); in Bedtime it can be text (5.0:1+).

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: KHEELU BLUE, the logo's sky blue (the K's ear, h, l, n). Everyday buttons and selection (`primary`), colour blocks, stickers, avatars and artwork, always with white on it: 3.0:1, below WCAG AA, a brand decision (10 Oct 2026) like white on Chilli, so keep it to bold labels, icons and big words. Never text or a thin line on cream or white (2.7:1).

tokens.name: sun-500
tokens.usage: SUNSHINE, the one accent: highlighter swipes, offer stickers, badges, small counts, and warnings. Always `ink-900` on it (10.8:1). Never text on light grounds (1.4:1); in Bedtime it can be text (9.9:1+).

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Success in Day: text and icons (4.9:1+ on light grounds), or a fill with cream or white text (5.5:1+). Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: green-300
tokens.usage: Success in Bedtime: text and icons on night grounds (8.6:1+).

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions in Day (4.7:1+ on light grounds), and the one danger fill: a confirm dialog's final button, with white text (5.7:1). A true red, well away from Chilli's orange. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: red-300
tokens.usage: Errors in Bedtime: text and icons on night grounds (6.4:1+).

tokens.name: night-100
tokens.usage: Bedtime page background (the app's night mode, bedtime story screens).

tokens.name: night-200
tokens.usage: Bedtime band: alternating bands, input fills and quiet panels.

tokens.name: night-300
tokens.usage: Bedtime raised surface: cards, sheets, menus.

tokens.name: night-500
tokens.usage: Bedtime hairlines and dividers (decorative).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background. Pair with `text` / `text-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, menus. Pair with `text` / `text-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: Alternating bands, input fills, table headers and every quiet panel: quotes, FAQs, tips, notices, offer details.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on any `surface*` (13.0:1+ Day, 13.4:1+ Bedtime).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on any `surface*` (6.0:1+ Day, 10.2:1+ Bedtime).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card hairlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: inputs, toggles, outline icon buttons (3.4:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: The buy button: Pre-order Kheelu, Reserve for ₹499, Buy. One per view, and the only control that is Chilli.

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `cta`: white on Chilli, 2.9:1, below WCAG AA (4.5:1) and the 3:1 large-text minimum, kept by brand decision on 9 Oct 2026.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Everyday actions (Continue, Save, Connect Kheelu) and selection: checked boxes, radios and switches, the selected mode and tags, the current tab-bar item, progress bars. Kheelu Blue in both themes, always with white on it.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text, ticks, dots, thumbs and icons on `primary`: white, 3.0:1 in both themes. Below WCAG AA (4.5:1) and the 3:1 large-text minimum; kept by brand decision on 10 Oct 2026, like `on-cta`.

tokens.name: deep-blue
tokens.usage: Blue-family text and lines on any `surface*`: eyebrows, handwritten accents, links, icons in tiles, the selected-tab and current-page underline. Ink in Day, because Kheelu Blue is too light to read on cream (2.7:1); Kheelu Blue in Bedtime (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, always underlined: ink in Day (13.0:1+), Kheelu Blue in Bedtime (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: deep-chilli
tokens.usage: Chilli-toned text and icons: ink in Day, because orange is too light to read on cream (2.7:1); orange in Bedtime (5.0:1+).

tokens.name: deep-sun
tokens.usage: Sunshine-toned text and icons: ink in Day (sunshine is 1.4:1 on cream); sunshine in Bedtime (9.9:1+).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (13.0:1+). On brand fills bundle.css switches it to `ink-900` (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: Imagination-layer chalk lines and sticker outlines, on photos, the chalkboard and brand fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons ('Kheelu is connected'). Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings ('Battery low') are a Sunshine badge or icon circle with `ink-900` on it (10.8:1), always with an icon and a word. Never sunshine text on light grounds.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions ('Delete conversation'): text, icons and outlines. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, bottom sheets and the menu drawer (night-100 at 50%).

families.display: "Baloo 2", "Baloo Da 2", "Baloo Tammudu 2", "Baloo Thambi 2", "Baloo Tamma 2", "Nunito", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: kh-display-xl
styles.usage: Web hero headline at 1024px and wider. One per page. Mobile: use display-m.

styles.name: kh-display-l
styles.usage: Tablet hero, deck title slides, big section openers.

styles.name: kh-display-m
styles.sample: A loop that learns your child.
styles.usage: Section headings (H2) on web; the hero headline on phones.

styles.name: kh-headline
styles.sample: What your child gets, year by year.
styles.usage: Mobile H2 (SectionHeading on phones), deck slide titles, social post headlines and big stat numbers.

styles.name: kh-title
styles.usage: Card titles, modal titles, app screen titles.

styles.name: kh-subtitle
styles.usage: Small card titles, FAQ questions, list group headers.

styles.name: kh-price
styles.usage: Prices in the OfferCard and pricing slides. Always with the ₹ sign and Indian digit grouping.

styles.name: kh-hand-l
styles.usage: The ONE handwritten word or short phrase inside a display headline. Colour: `deep-chilli`, `deep-blue` or ink. Tilt −2° to −4°.

styles.name: kh-hand-m
styles.usage: Handwritten accents on stickers, cards, deck callouts, social posts.

styles.name: kh-note
styles.usage: Annotations on photos and Imagination-layer labels, in chalk on photos or ink on fur.

styles.name: kh-lead
styles.sample: Kheelu listens, remembers, and grows with your child.
styles.usage: Hero subheadlines and section intros. Max 60 characters per line. On phones it steps down to 18/28 at the same weight.

styles.name: kh-body-l
styles.sample: New ideas arrive inside everyday conversation, not forced drills.
styles.usage: Long reading: journal, safety, FAQ answers on desktop.

styles.name: kh-body
styles.sample: You see every conversation. You decide what Kheelu does next.
styles.usage: Default paragraph and UI text on web and app.

styles.name: kh-body-s
styles.sample: Prices include GST. Full refund until we ship.
styles.usage: Helper text, footnotes, dense app lists.

styles.name: kh-label-l
styles.usage: Large buttons: the OfferCard and menu-drawer buy buttons, hero calls to action.

styles.name: kh-label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, segmented controls, nav links.

styles.name: kh-label-s
styles.usage: Chips, tags, stickers, small buttons, form labels, table headers.

styles.name: kh-eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above section headings, uppercase, in `deep-chilli` or `deep-blue`. Max 4 words.

styles.name: kh-caption
styles.usage: Image captions, attributions, timestamps, meta text in rows, legal fine print. Badges and counters use it at 800.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Sections breathe (space-8/9); cards are cosy (space-5). Components use these steps only; 1–2px nudges that line up an icon or a hairline are the one exception.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips, badges and stickers; the inset of segmented controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its text; between stacked chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and small stickers; gap in tight lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; gap between a heading and its paragraph; input padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large card padding (OfferCard); gap between heading block and content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; gap between sub-sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop; deck title-slide margins.

radius.note: Soft like plush. Nothing in Kheelona has a sharp corner except tables' inner grid.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tiny tags, focus-ring corners on small items.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menu items, focus corners and 40px icon tiles in lists and settings rows.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Inputs, small cards, app stat tiles, alerts, toasts and menus.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards, photo frames, FAQ items, testimonial cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero blocks, big colour panels, social post tiles, deck panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, stickers, toggles, the announcement bar.

shadow.note: Flat by default. One tactile ink edge for buttons, one lift for floating things, one soft shadow for stickers.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: The chunky toy-like base edge under every button (cta, primary, secondary) and the OfferCard: ink in Day, a dark edge in Bedtime. Buttons drop 4px onto it when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Floating things only: sticky buy bar, menus, popovers, the product on a plain ground.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Under sticker cut-outs (kids or Kheelu with a white outline) placed on colour blocks.

size.note: Touch targets, icon sizes and measures.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height/width of anything a parent taps (web and app).

tokens.name: tap-kid
tokens.usage: Minimum target for anything a child might press (kid-facing screens, setup on the toy).

tokens.name: icon-s
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips and captions.

tokens.name: icon-m
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: icon-l
tokens.usage: Standalone UI icons, nav, app tab bar.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Spot icons in an 80px circle: empty states and other illustrative moments.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for paragraphs.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on web; full-bleed colour blocks may go wider.

stroke.note: Line weights for borders and hand-drawn marks.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers, card, list and table frames (`border`).

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, toggles, tags, secondary buttons and the OfferCard frame (`border-strong` or ink); the tab track.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus rings (2px offset), the selected tab underline and the nav-link underline.

tokens.name: stroke-chalk
tokens.usage: Imagination-layer chalk lines at 1x on a 1080px-wide photo (scale with the image), and the white ring around Sticker chips.

tokens.name: stroke-sticker
tokens.usage: White sticker outline around cut-out kids, Kheelu and the sticker logo at 1080px; 4px on phones.

motion.note: Quick and gentle, like a toy wobbling back into place. Under prefers-reduced-motion, movement stops and only fades remain.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Presses, hovers, tooltips, checkbox and radio feedback.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: State changes: switches, carets, accordion signs, progress bars.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving: sheets, toasts, stickers popping on. Pair with ease-bounce.

tokens.name: duration-draw
tokens.usage: Chalk doodles drawing on (600–900ms by size), once per view, never looping.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition unless it is an entrance.

tokens.name: ease-bounce
tokens.usage: Entrances: a small overshoot that settles.

zIndex.note: Layers stack in this order. Dialogs and bottom sheets use the browser's top layer and need no z-index.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The sticky buy bar and sticky headers.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus and other popovers.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: The menu drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
